## Summary & Identity
Jay Soni (Soni Jaykumar Hasmukh) is an award-winning Lead Mobile & Full-Stack Architect and Software Engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He currently leads mobile and full-stack software architecture at NB Developers / NB PropertyTech in Science City, Ahmedabad. 

In October 2026, he was awarded the Certificate of Appreciation (Reward & Recognition Award) by NB Infra Projects Limited (Since 1946), signed by Founder & Chairman Rahul D. Prajapati, for exceptional quarterly engineering leadership, zero-downtime architecture, and production delivery.

## Key Technical Competencies
- Mobile Engineering: Flutter, Flutter Desktop (Win32/DWM), Dart, Android Studio, Java 17 Desugaring, Target SDK 36 (Android 15), ProGuard.
- Architecture: Offline-First Architectures, Local Embedded Isar NoSQL (2ms–8ms reads), BLoC, Riverpod, Repository Pattern, Realtime Synchronization.
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js 14/15 (App Router, Standalone mode), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, WebGL / CanvasKit GPU optimization.
- Backend & Systems: Node.js, NestJS 10, Express 5, PostgreSQL (Enterprise Migrations 1–93), Prisma v6, Natural Language AI Search Engines, Supabase Realtime & Row-Level Security (RLS), RFC 6238 TOTP 2FA, Docker, Traefik Reverse Proxy with Automated SSL.
- Security & Devops: 100/100 automated security audit score, Docker containerization, GitHub Actions CI/CD to VPS, Inno Setup 6, Hostinger SSL SMTP.
